basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech support specialist based in Salt Lake City. I've recently gotten into fencing as a hobby and love watching basketball, particularly the Utah Jazz. I'm still learning the ropes on Reddit, but I'm enjoying the community aspect of it, especially when it comes to discussing hobbies. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. I'm single and live with my two dogs, who I love taking on hikes around the Utah mountains.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and work in tech support. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on experience and troubleshooting various tech issues. I'm also self-taught in fencing, having picked it up through online tutorials and local club sessions.
